subject.title: Use shared Spark subscription review rails

question: Should this repository authorize forwarding CLAWSWEEPER_DISPATCH_TOKEN to the SHA-pinned shared ClawSweeper reusable workflow?
rationale: The repository policy requires separate authorization for secrets or permissions changes, and that approval is not present in the admitted discussion.

options.title: Authorize the pinned relay
options.body: Approve this exact SHA-pinned reusable-workflow secret boundary after reviewing the receiving workflow and attach the authorization to this PR.

options.title: Keep the relay disabled
options.body: Do not merge the secret-forwarding path until a locally contained or otherwise approved review route is available.

recommendation.title: Authorize the pinned relay
